name: Ancient Altar
summary:
Hey!

You there!

Burned to death by the dragonfly again?

Got devoured by the hounds too many times?

Need better gear than your old log suit and 1% spear?

Then you need the ANCIENT ALTAR mod!

With the ANCIENT ALTAR you can craft thulecite fragments, the (broken) Ancient Pseudoscience Station and all the recipes that come with it!

Jump with joy as you use THE LAZY FORAGER to grab the items your teammates leave lying around (If they say you're stealing, blame the amulet!).

Become the fanciest person (or robot (or monster)) around with the THULECITE CROWN! Not only it reduces your damage taken, but it gives you an almighty shield once in a while. It also make you automatically the KING of the camp!

People disagree with your position as king? Grab the powerful THULECITE CLUB and SHOW EM WHO'S BOSS!
